description: Named-human decisions for explicit TR1894 to Reader-token one-to-many mappings that exact surface comparison cannot establish.

decisions.reason: TR1894 has the single compound imperative ὑψηλοφρόνει where the Reader SBLGNT spine has the two-token expression ὑψηλὰ φρόνει. The approved LPF unit ‘seas arrogante’ remains attached to the authoritative TR token and must address both comparison terminals in the Reader.
